findings.shown: The four frozen commands use python -m uvicorn. All 128 source pins match the prior records; application pins include /usr/local/bin/uvicorn and uvicorn/main.py, config.py, importer.py, server.py and lifespan/on.py, but no uvicorn/__main__.py. The linked startup/source-policy reviews inspected here do not supply a hash-bound module-launcher equivalence assessment.
findings.unverified: The exact package-module launcher selected by the new commands and its delegation/startup effects. This is not a finding that the launcher is unsafe or that runtime startup has failed.
findings.why_material: The old restricted acceptance explicitly characterizes the exact configured Uvicorn startup. Module execution adds the package __main__ entry path; a reviewed console script and uvicorn/main.py alone do not characterize the unreviewed module shim. That shim could alter invocation or perform effects before reaching the already-reviewed CLI. Unchanged image identity makes archived same-image evidence reusable, but does not substitute for the missing source/semantic bridge.
findings.minimum_missing_evidence: Hash-bound readable bytes of the resolved Uvicorn package launcher, normally /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/uvicorn/__main__.py, tied to all four exact image/subject bindings or demonstrated immutable/source-only lineage. Narrow static review must establish its delegation to the already-pinned CLI and characterize any added startup effects/settings. If source-origin resolution is ambiguous under the saved workdir/PYTHONPATH, resolve only that ambiguity with bounded non-secret configuration/source evidence.
findings.minimum_readonly_capture_requirement: Reuse suitable existing saved exact-image bytes if available. Otherwise, under separate explicit authorization, capture only this fixed launcher file from the four accepted stopped containers as bounded read-only source bytes with container ID, image ID, path, size and SHA256. Identical payloads may be deduplicated only with evidence for each binding/lineage. No launcher execution, imports, startup, service calls, credentials, broad filesystem search or complete dependency-closure capture is required.
findings.closure_boundary: This review performs no capture and authors no accepted policy/runtime derivatives. Once this narrow bridge is supplied, reassess applicability to the exact commands under the unchanged restricted meanings; do not silently promote every image operation to SHOWN.
